scripts.dev:cockpit: npm run build && wrangler pages dev dist --local --persist-to .wrangler/state/cockpit --ip 127.0.0.1 --port 8788 --compatibility-date 2026-03-02 --d1 COCKPIT_DB=00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 --binding COCKPIT_LOCAL_BYPASS=1

scripts.db:cockpit:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply levois-cockpit-local --local --config wrangler.cockpit.toml --persist-to .wrangler/state/cockpit
